==Objectives==
Speak with Hydromancer Finnigan in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor.

==Description==
That good-for-nothing Finnigan! I swear, someday one of his escapades will be the end of him. You see, not long ago a group of SI:7 agents gathered at the docks. Apparently, from what we could overhear, they were on their way to complete a dangerous mission on the island just off the coast of Westfall. Balor is its name. That island has been drenched in a never-ending thunderstorm even well before we settled here in Davenburg. Kul Tiras has been in contact with Balor and its people in the past, so the place is not unknown to us.

Be that as it may, Finnigan, our local hydromancer, actually volunteered in helping the SI:7 with their assignment on Balor and is now with them in their outpost. We need him back here in Davenburg as soon as possible, so as to not jeopardize our diplomatic mission. <class>, would you be willing to help him finish whatever he started, so that he can return to us? One of the agents stayed back at the southern docks, I am sure he can take you to the island.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* 360 XP

==Completion==
Hornby sent you? That fool is too soft for his own good. I appreciate the sentiment, but what is happening here exceeds whatever I was assigned to in Davenburg by far. Out of the question. He is right in one thing, however. Should you aid me in my research, I'd be quicker to return to the mainland. So, what do you say?
